name: Caselaw Access Project
tagline: Harvard CAP API for millions of digitized US court opinions with structured metadata
description: The Caselaw Access Project (CAP) API from Harvard Law School Library provides programmatic access to millions of digitized US court opinions with structured metadata. Developers can search and retrieve case law data for legal research, analytics, and application integration.

auth.details: API key authentication required for most endpoints

use_cases: search US court opinions by keyword
retrieve case metadata and full text by ID
list cases by jurisdiction or court
bulk export of caselaw data for research
